# 1. Prepare input for dNdScv
```{r pressure, echo=FALSE} 
## DN/DS
non_syn <- c("Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "Splice_Site", "Translation_Start_Site", "Nonsense_Mutation", 
             "Nonstop_Mutation", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins", "Missense_Mutation")

## MAF from VCF
pcawgmaf_input <- "${path_rsrch}/PCAWG/consensus_snv_indel/maf_from_vcf/maf_pcawg_vcf.maf"
maf_out <- "${path_rsrch}/PCAWG/consensus_snv_indel/maf_from_vcf/"
data <- fread(pcawgmaf_input)
dim(data)

## maf without all nonsyn HLA mutations
hla_genes <- c("HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C")

## dNdScv without all nonsyn HLA mutations
data_noHLAnonsyn <- fread(paste0(maf_out, "/maf_pcawg_vcf_noHLA.maf"))
mutations <- data_noHLAnonsyn %>% select(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Chromosome, Start_Position, Tumor_Seq_Allele1, Tumor_Seq_Allele2)
names(mutations) <- c("sampleID", "chr", "pos", "ref", "mut")
write.table(mutations, file = paste0(maf_out, "/mutations_dNdScvnoHLAnonsyn.txt"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

## Samples with consensus HLA mutations
data_HLA <- fread(paste0(maf_out, "/maf_pcawg_vcf_nonsyn_consensusHLA.maf")) %>% 
distinct(Hugo_Symbol, Variant_Classification, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% 
mutate(Start_position_dnds = Start_Position, 
       End_position_dnds = End_Position,
       Tumor_Seq_Allele1_dnds = Tumor_Seq_Allele1, 
       Tumor_Seq_Allele2_dnds = Tumor_Seq_Allele2) %>%
dplyr::select(Hugo_Symbol, Variant_Classification, Start_position_dnds, End_position_dnds,Tumor_Seq_Allele1_dnds, Tumor_Seq_Allele2_dnds) 

## dNdScv without polysolver
path_poly = "${path_rsrch}/PCAWG/MHC_evolution/HLAmutation/results/"
HLAmut_icgc <- fread(paste0(path_poly, "/maf_icgc_HLAmut_final.maf"))
HLAmut_tcga <- fread(paste0(path_poly, "/maf_tcga_HLAmut_final.maf"))

HLAmut_pcawg <- rbind(HLAmut_icgc, HLAmut_tcga, fill= TRUE) %>% 
left_join(.,data_HLA, by = c("Hugo_Symbol", "Variant_Classification")) %>%
mutate(Start_Position = ifelse(!is.na(Start_position_dnds), Start_position_dnds, Start_Position),
       End_position = ifelse(!is.na(End_position_dnds), End_position_dnds, End_Position),
       Tumor_Seq_Allele1 = ifelse(!is.na(Tumor_Seq_Allele1_dnds), Tumor_Seq_Allele1_dnds, Tumor_Seq_Allele1), 
       Tumor_Seq_Allele2 = ifelse(!is.na(Tumor_Seq_Allele2_dnds), Tumor_Seq_Allele2_dnds, Tumor_Seq_Allele2)) %>% 
       select(Tumor_Sample_Barcode, Chromosome, Start_Position, Tumor_Seq_Allele1, Tumor_Seq_Allele2)
names(HLAmut_pcawg) <- c("sampleID", "chr", "pos", "ref", "mut")
write.table(HLAmut_pcawg, file = paste0(maf_out, "/mutations_dNdScvPloyHLA.txt"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)

mutations_all <- rbind(mutations, HLAmut_pcawg)
write.table(mutations_all, file = paste0(maf_out, "/mutations_dNdScv_updated_withsynHLA.txt"), sep = "\t", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
```

# 2. APM
```{r}
APM <- c("HLA-A", "HLA-B", "HLA-C","B2M", "NLRC5", "TAP1", "TAP2" ,"TAPBP",  "PSMB8", "PSMB9", "PSMB10", "ERAP1", "ERAP2")
APM_pathway <- data.frame(Gene = APM, Pathway = rep("APM", length(APM)))

## MSS samples
allmut <- fread("/Users/wchen20/Desktop/PCAWG/MHC_evolution/DNDS/dNdScv/250807/mutations_dNdScv_updated_withsynHLA.txt") %>% 
  filter(sampleID %in% sample_MSS)

types <- "All-Cancer"
types <- unique(LOH_MSI$histology_abbreviation)

types <- c("All-Cancer", types)

for (type in types) {
  tryCatch({
    
    if (type == "All-Cancer") {
      sub_mutation <- allmut
    } else {
      
      sample_id <- subset(LOH_MSI, histology_abbreviation == type) %>% select(aliquot_id) %>% pull()
      
      # Select the subset of mutations based on the type and group, remove unnecessary columns
      sub_mutation <- allmut %>% filter(sampleID %in% !!sample_id) 
      
    }
    
    # Perform the dNdScv analysis
    dndsout = dndscv(sub_mutation, gene_list = APM, outmats= T)
    
    # Write out the selection coefficients
    sel_cv = dndsout$sel_cv
    write.table(sel_cv, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/sel_cv_", type, "_APM.csv"), sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    write_csv(sel_cv, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/sel_cv_", type, "_APM.csv"))
    
    ci = geneci(dndsout)
    write.table(ci, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/ci_", type, "_APM.csv"), sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    write_csv(ci, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/ci_", type, "_APM.csv"))
    
    # Filter and write out significant genes
    #signif_genes = sel_cv <- subset(sel_cv, qglobal_cv < 0.1) %>% select(gene_name, qglobal_cv)
    #rownames(signif_genes) = NULL
    #write.table(signif_genes, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/signif_genes_", type, "_APM.csv"), 
    #            sep = ",", row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE)
    
    # Write out the global dN/dS estimates
    globaldnds <- dndsout$globaldnds
    write_csv(globaldnds, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/globaldnds_", type, "_APM.csv"))
    
    # Write out annotated mutations
    annotmuts <- dndsout$annotmuts
    write_csv(annotmuts, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/annotmuts_", type, "_APM.csv"))
    
    # Write out the local model of dNdS
    localmodel = dndsout$sel_loc
    write_csv(localmodel, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/localmodel_", type, "_APM.csv"))
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    print(paste0("Error processing ", type, "_", "combination: ", e$message))
  })
}
```


# 3. Combine 
```{r}
file_list <- list.files(path = path_dNdScv, pattern = "globaldnds_*", recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)

dNdScv <- list()

for (file in file_list) {
  file_name <- basename(file)
  type <- basename(file_name)
  type <- gsub("globaldnds_|_APM.csv", "", type)
  dNdScv[[type]] <- fread(file) %>% mutate(type = type)
}

dnds_all <- rbindlist(dNdScv, fill = TRUE) %>% 
  mutate(log_mle = log2(mle),
         log_cihigh = log2(cihigh),
         log_cilow = log2(cilow),
         MLE = pmin(pmax(log_mle, -4), 4),
         upper = pmin(pmax(log_cihigh, -4.5), 4.5),
         lower = pmin(pmax(log_cilow, -4.5), 4.5)) %>%
  select(-log_mle, -log_cihigh, -log_cilow)
write_csv(dnds_all, file = paste0(path_dNdScv, "/all.csv"))
```
